thread_text:
Hector Alvarez: Hey folks  Hector here, starting remote from Manila on Eng-Platform. Laptop shipment hit customs so I'm using a personal MBP for now. Quick Qs: who to ping for temporary VPN creds and for JetBrains license? Also curious about devcontainer workflows vs local setup. Icebreaker: favorite childhood cereal? Mine was Cocoa Puffs.

Jun Park: Welcome Hector!! I'm Jun, your manager. Sorry about customs 62c. I'll ask Lucia to sort temporary VPN and we'll request a JetBrains seat from procurement. Also Arun will be your buddy for repo walkthrough.

Lucia (IT): Hi Hector, Lucia from IT. We can issue a time-limited VPN cert for remote onboarding and whitelist your current IP. DM me your home IP and Ill provision. For device enrollment once corporate laptop arrives we'll do Jamf MDM.

Hector Alvarez: Thanks Lucia  my IP is 112.198.45.67 (DMing as well). Any special instructions to avoid triggering corporate SSO from this machine?

Lucia (IT): Good call DMing it. For now we'll create a short-lived cert so you won't need SSO on personal device. Don't store company creds locally and use the browser with the guest profile when accessing internal wiki.

Arun - eng-platform: Hey Hector  devcontainer is the team's recommended path (consistent env). Quick start: clone the repo and run:

Arun - eng-platform: ```
git clone git@github.com:redwood/eng-platform.git
code . --folder-uri ./.devcontainer
# then click "Reopen in Container" in VS Code
```

Hector Alvarez: Sweet, I'll try devcontainer. For JetBrains license, is that requested via the access form or a different one?

Jun Park: Use the software request form under procurement and tag @Lucia for approval. I'll also approve from my side.

Dev Tools Bot: FYI 4e2a - JetBrains seats currently have a short wait (1-2 business days). You can use the community edition in the meantime or the VS Code devcontainer.

HR Bot: Reminder 514 - complete payroll and benefits forms within 72 hours: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding. If you need an international payroll setup, DM @Jun.

Hector Alvarez: Update: temporary VPN cert received and connected  thanks Lucia! Submitted the procurement form for JetBrains. Also confirmed: Cocoa Puffs was my cereal of choice 366. Looking forward to the repo walkthrough with Arun.

Arun - eng-platform: Welcome again! We'll pair tomorrow morning Manila time and I'll show the CI checks and local debugging tips. See you then.
